product.name: Oversized Fit Printed Hoodie
product.description: Oversized-fit sweatshirt hoodie in medium-weight, cotton-blend fabric with a printed motif and extra-loose silhouette. Double-layered wrapover hood, a kangaroo pocket, heavily dropped shoulders, and long sleeves. Ribbing at cuffs and hem. Soft, brushed inside.
